바꾸다.m: to change, to exchange, to switch
바꾸다.ex: 이 옷을 큰 사이즈로 바꿔 주세요.
바꾸다.x: Please exchange these clothes for a bigger size.
바꾸다.e: Also exchange: 돈을 바꾸다 = exchange money; 바꿔 주세요 = please switch it.

자르다.forms: 잘라요 · 잘랐어요 · 자를 거예요 · 자르세요 (르 irregular)
자르다.x: I got my hair cut at the hair salon yesterday.
자르다.t: 르 irregular: 자르 + 아요 → 잘라요. 머리를 잘랐어요 also means 'I got a haircut.'

땀.ex: 한 시간 동안 운동을 해서 땀을 많이 흘렸어요.
땀.x: I exercised for an hour and sweated a lot.

무지개.ex: 비가 그친 후에 하늘에 무지개가 떴어요.
무지개.x: After the rain stopped, a rainbow appeared in the sky.
무지개.e: Probably from old words for 'water' and 'gate' — a water gate in the sky.

꺼지다.m: to go off, to turn off, to go out (light, fire); to die (battery)
꺼지다.x: My phone suddenly died because the battery ran out.
꺼지다.e: 끄다 'to turn off' + -어지다 'become'; the ㅡ drops.
꺼지다.t: Careful: 꺼져! said to a person is a rude 'Get lost!'

김.x: Rice is delicious wrapped in seaweed.
김.e: Homonym warning: 김 also means 'steam', and it's a very common family name.
김.t: Seaweed for soup is 미역; 김 is the thin, dried, roasted sheets.

메뉴판.x: Excuse me, could you show me the menu?
메뉴판.t: 메뉴 alone often means the dishes themselves: 오늘 메뉴가 뭐예요? 'What's on today?'

지난주.x: I went to a friend's birthday party last week.
지난주.t: 지난주 is written as one word, but 다음 주 and 이번 주 take a space.

그러면.m: then, in that case, if so

와.forms: 와! (exclamation); stretched 와아 or 우와 for extra excitement
와.x: Wow, the view here is really beautiful!
와.e: Homonym warning: 와 is also the particle 'and', as in 사과와 배.

뱀.ex: 저는 어렸을 때부터 뱀이 정말 무서워요.
뱀.x: I've been really scared of snakes since I was little.

게시판.m: bulletin board; message board, online forum
게시판.x: The notices are posted on the bulletin board.
게시판.t: It also means an online message board, where you 글을 올리다 (post something).

공연장.ex: 공연장 앞에 사람들이 길게 줄을 서 있어요.
공연장.x: People are standing in a long line in front of the concert hall.
공연장.e: -장 = place for an activity: 공연장, 운동장, 주차장.

온난화.x: Because of warming, sea temperatures are rising.

우연히.x: I ran into a high school friend on the street by chance.

여기다.m: to regard, to consider, to think of (as)
여기다.x: I think of that friend as family.
여기다.e: Unrelated to 여기 'here', despite the identical spelling of the stem.
여기다.t: Common patterns: N을/를 N(으)로 여기다 and A-게 여기다, as in 소중하게 여기다 'to treasure'.

쓸모없다.x: These things are useless now, so I'll throw them away.
쓸모없다.e: 쓸모 (use, usefulness, from 쓰다 'to use') + 없다 'not have'.
쓸모없다.t: Pronounced [쓸모업따]; the modifier is 쓸모없는, not 쓸모없은.

동작.ex: 이 동작은 어려워서 몇 번 더 연습해야 해요.
동작.x: This move is hard, so I need to practice it a few more times.
동작.t: In dance class you'll hear 동작을 크게 하세요 'make your moves bigger'. 동작이 빠르다 / 느리다 = to be quick / slow in moving.

업종.ex: 요즘 어떤 업종이 가장 인기가 많아요?
업종.x: Which type of business is the most popular these days?
업종.t: 업종 is a category of business; 직종 is a category of job.

폭락.ex: 주가 폭락으로 많은 투자자들이 돈을 잃었습니다.
폭락.x: Many investors lost money due to the stock crash.
폭락.e: Literally 'violent fall' — the opposite of 폭등.
폭락.t: Pronounced [퐁낙]: double nasalization of ㄱ and ㄹ.

방영.ex: 그 드라마는 다음 달부터 방영될 예정이에요.
방영.x: That drama is scheduled to air starting next month.

등장인물.x: This drama has too many characters.
등장인물.e: Literally 'people who step onto the stage'.

그나마.m: even so, at least, fortunately; even that little
그나마.ex: 다쳤지만 그나마 크게 다치지 않아서 다행이에요.
그나마.x: I got hurt, but at least it wasn't serious.
그나마.e: 그 'that' + -나마 'even if only': taking comfort in the little there is.

차리다.m: to set (a table), prepare (a meal); to open (a business); to come to (one's senses)
차리다.x: My mom made us a delicious dinner.
차리다.t: 정신 차려! means 'Pull yourself together!' or 'Wake up!'.

흐트러지다.m: to be scattered, be messed up; to lose focus
흐트러지다.ex: 밖에 나가자마자 바람 때문에 머리가 흐트러졌어요.
흐트러지다.x: As soon as I went outside, the wind messed up my hair.
흐트러지다.t: Also figurative: 자세가 흐트러지다 (posture slips), 마음이 흐트러지다 (mind wanders).

떳떳하다.m: honorable, proud, having nothing to be ashamed of
떳떳하다.x: I did nothing wrong, so I have nothing to be ashamed of.
떳떳하다.t: Pronounced [떧떠타다]; the feeling of a clear conscience — 떳떳하게 말하다.

파김치가 되다.m: to be dead tired, to be completely worn out
파김치가 되다.ex: 하루 종일 이사를 해서 파김치가 됐어요.
파김치가 되다.x: I spent the whole day moving and I'm completely wiped out.
파김치가 되다.e: 파김치 = green-onion kimchi; you're as limp as wilted, pickled scallions.

서바이벌 프로그램.x: Many groups debuted through survival shows.
서바이벌 프로그램.e: From English 'survival' + 'program'; English usually says 'competition show'.
서바이벌 프로그램.t: Contestants are eliminated round by round, often by viewer votes (투표), and the finalists debut together as a group.

킥킥.e: Sound word (의성어) for laughter you try to hold in.
킥킥.t: 킥킥거리다 and 킥킥대다 are common: 수업 시간에 킥킥거리다.

꽥꽥.x: The ducks are quacking in the pond.
꽥꽥.e: Sound word (의성어) for a duck's quack or a shrill shout.
꽥꽥.t: 꽥 alone is a sudden shriek: 소리를 꽥 지르다 'to let out a yell'.

체하다.forms: 체해요 · 체했어요 · 체할 거예요 · 체한 것 같아요
체하다.ex: 점심을 급하게 먹었더니 체한 것 같아요.
체하다.x: I ate lunch too fast, and I think it's given me indigestion.
체하다.e: 滯 'stuck, blocked' + 하다: food that won't go down.
체하다.t: A very common Korean complaint: the heavy feeling of food 'stuck' after eating too fast. People take 소화제, and some still use the folk remedy of pricking a fingertip (손을 따다).

독자층.ex: 이 잡지는 주로 이십 대가 독자층이에요.
독자층.x: This magazine's readership is mostly people in their twenties.
독자층.e: Literally 'layer of readers'; -층 = a social group: 젊은 층, 고객층.

착각.ex: 오늘이 일요일인 줄 알고 잠깐 착각했어요.
착각.x: I briefly got confused and thought today was Sunday.

정복.x: Alexander the Great conquered a vast area.

삭막하다.x: City life sometimes feels bleak and cold.
삭막하다.e: Describes both empty landscapes and emotionally cold places, like big cities.

혹독하다.x: The cold this winter was really bitter.
혹독하다.t: Typical with weather and training: 혹독한 추위, 혹독한 훈련.

도리없이.m: with no other way, inevitably, helplessly
도리없이.x: The traffic was so bad that I had no choice but to walk.
도리없이.e: Literally 'without a way (도리) to do it'.
도리없이.t: Often spaced as 도리 없이; the predicate form is 도리가 없어요 'There's no way.'

이기심.ex: 인간의 이기심 때문에 환경 문제가 심각해졌어요.
이기심.x: Environmental problems have become serious because of human selfishness.
이기심.e: Literally 'a heart that benefits only oneself'.

테러리스트.ex: 경찰은 공항에서 테러리스트 두 명을 체포했습니다.
테러리스트.x: Police arrested two terrorists at the airport.

통화량.ex: 통화량이 늘어나면 물가가 오를 수 있습니다.
통화량.x: When the money supply increases, prices can rise.
통화량.t: 통화 also means 'phone call' (通話); 통화량 can mean 'call volume' in telecom contexts.

자가당착.ex: 그의 주장은 앞뒤가 맞지 않는 자가당착에 빠졌어요.
자가당착.x: His argument fell into self-contradiction, with its parts not fitting together.
자가당착.e: Literally 'one's own house colliding': your own words clash with each other.
자가당착.t: A four-character idiom, usually in 자가당착에 빠지다 (to fall into self-contradiction).

시한부.x: She was told she had six months to live.

현대사.x: The Korean War was a great tragedy in modern Korean history.

억측하다.m: to speculate (groundlessly), to make wild guesses
억측하다.x: Don't speculate about things that aren't certain.
억측하다.e: Literally 'guess by one's own thoughts' — guessing without evidence.
억측하다.t: More often used as a noun: 억측이 난무하다 = wild speculation runs rampant.

역행하다.m: to go against, to run counter to
역행하다.ex: 그 정책은 시대의 흐름에 역행한다는 비판을 받았어요.
역행하다.x: The policy was criticized for going against the trend of the times.
역행하다.t: Set phrase: 시대에 역행하다 'to go against the times'.

경력단절.m: career break, career interruption (esp. women leaving work for childcare)
경력단절.ex: 출산 후 경력단절을 겪는 여성이 많습니다.
경력단절.x: Many women experience a career break after giving birth.
경력단절.t: Pronounced [경녁딴절]; the slang 경단녀 is short for 경력단절여성.

월간지.ex: 저는 여행 월간지를 정기 구독하고 있어요.
월간지.x: I have a subscription to a monthly travel magazine.
